answer: The ledge ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the whisper snapshot records each drop, and the nebula score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Buying an aged account as a result buys something that is already decaying, and an adversary's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 10 epochs without a passing answer. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
